summary: BOLIGSAMEIE GRENSEGATA 54 SKIEN (org. no. 998 429 420) is a condominium (ESEK) based in Skien, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2012-05-30. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 97.001 (Aktiviteter i borettslag og boligsameier); it has 0 registered employees. Board chair: Camilla Leah Arneberg.
